paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.79% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-0.10%) and Nasdaq weakest (-4.14%). Brent crude changed -2.22% to 89.37. Gold changed -1.93% to 3,493.2. Bitcoin changed -3.48% to 57,667.2812. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.83%, a relative move of -1.51%. Among the firms tracked, Newmont (-4.90%) and Lazard (-4.57%) moved the most.
